support_kind: direct WNT4-FZD6 CRD biochemical complex;canonical context;LRP5 unresolved
evidence_summary: In canine MDCK cells, WNT4 activated TCF/LEF-dependent canonical reporter readouts and WNT4 formed a biochemical complex with the FZD6 cysteine-rich domain.
